Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 109: May 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #109 shipped to subscribers in April 2010 (bearing the cover date of May 2010 for Issue 109). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #109 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands (action-adventure platformer)
Green Day: Rock Band (rhythm music game)
Naughty Bear (action-adventure stealth comedy)
Snoopy Flying Ace (Xbox Live Arcade aerial combat)
Ben 10 Alien Force: The Rise of Hex (Xbox Live Arcade action-platformer)
Doom II (Xbox Live Arcade retro FPS port)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Call of Duty: Black Ops, Batman: Arkham City, and Brink, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
